LBM Re100 cavity: actual2D fields and Ghia centerlines Advance genuine four-wall BGK flow on three fixed grids, checking nominal-lid Ghia centerlines, primary vortex, stationarity and wall momentum budgets. Assumptions, units and boundaries Physical unit square, lid1, viscosity.01, Re100; N24/32/48, lattice lid.04, dt=.04/N. Three stationary walls/rightward lid; stationary side owns a simultaneous top/side link. Initialrho1/rest. Editorial clarification Three finite-Mach educational grids. Ghia is a rounded independent numerical reference, not exact. No pointwise corner order/high-Re claim or borrowed success from another cavity solver. A standard C++17compiler is required. Adopted numerical method Standard D2Q9equilibrium/BGK collision, nonperiodic link streaming and moving halfway reflection atq=.5. Sum actual population wall impulses without density repair/interior reset.
